name: Grimsby
doing: watching the world go by on the terrace of De Turk
thought: This is the third time today I’ve found something worth eating and had to decide whether it’s worth the trouble of being seen with it.

feeling.words: Dawn licks the tiles. The silence is a thin crust. I count the cracks in the roof like a list I can’t afford to miss.

place.name: De Turk
place.words: on the terrace of De Turk
